visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a POV perspective of a wide asphalt road under a clear, bright blue sky. A white car drives ahead, and the road is lined with green trees and yellow traffic markings. (2) A female rider wearing a black jacket and a black SHARK helmet with a multi-colored visor appears, looking directly at the camera. She is mounted on a red motorcycle. (3) The POV returns, showing the rider approaching an intersection with traffic lights and a speed camera warning sign. (4) The camera shifts to a front-facing shot of the rider at a stoplight; she performs rhythmic hand gestures and body swaying, appearing to dance. Another motorcyclist in black gear is visible in the background. (5) A large yellow utility truck with the logo 'D.E.P.K.' pulls up next to the rider. The middle-aged male driver rolls down his window, smiling and gesturing. The rider responds with a thumbs-up and waves. (6) The video ends on a black screen with white and red text and a stylized white bird logo at the top right.
